description: Implementation of AdaptiveAudioDecoder class for internal audio decoding, including initialization, decoding, output handling, and reset logic within the starboard media framework.

classes.name: AdaptiveAudioDecoder
classes.description: A class that manages adaptive audio decoding, including initialization, decoding, output processing, and resetting, with support for format adjustments and resampling.

methods.name: AdaptiveAudioDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decoder with stream info, DRM system, and optional reset capability.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up output and error callback functions.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Processes input buffers for decoding, handling configuration changes.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Retrieves decoded audio data and sample rate.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state, optionally resetting the internal decoder.

methods.name: InitializeAudioDecoder
methods.description: Creates and initializes the internal audio decoder based on stream info.

methods.name: TeardownAudioDecoder
methods.description: Destroys the internal decoder and related resources.

methods.name: ResetInternal
methods.description: Resets internal state variables and clears buffers.

methods.name: OnDecoderOutput
methods.description: Handles output from the internal decoder, including resampling, format adjustment, and end-of-stream processing.
